newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: AND Int Pub acquires UK maps firm.
newsitem.headline: AND Int Pub acquires UK maps firm.

text.p: AND International Publishers Plc said it had agreed to buy the British company European Map Graphics Ltd for about one million pounds sterling.
AND described Finchhamstead-based EMG as one of Europe's leading companies in the fields of cartographic services and small-scale cartographic databases.
EMG had sales of some one million sterling in 1996 and a pre-tax profit of some 70,000 sterling. It employs 26 people.
AND said the acquisition would be paid partly in cash and partly in AND shares, with the exact terms to be set later.
AND -- listed in Amsterdam and on London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) -- specialises in electronic publishing, mapping and identification systems.
